description: This file defines interfaces related to stream checkpointing in Orleans, including a factory interface for creating checkpointers and a generic checkpointing interface for managing stream checkpoints.

classes.name: IStreamQueueCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Provides a method to create stream checkpointers for specific partitions.

classes.name: IStreamQueueCheckpointer<TCheckpoint>
classes.description: Defines methods and properties for checkpointing a stream, including loading, updating, and checking existence of checkpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a stream checkpointer for a specified partition.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint with a new offset and timestamp.
